Adventure Island.name: Adventure Island
Adventure Island.summary: Master Higgins' girlfriend Tina, has just been kidnapped by the Evil Witch Doctor's persistent followers. Despite its English title, this is a handheld port of Adventure Island II, not its predecessor.

Bo Jackson - Two Games in One.name: Bo Jackson: Two Games in One
Bo Jackson - Two Games in One.summary: It's two games in one -- play either baseball or football in this game headlined by Bo Jackson. In baseball, you can participate in all the major parts of the ballgame, such as pitching, hitting, and fielding. The field is displayed in 3D using an engine called "3-D Sensation." In football, the field is displayed as an overhead view in 2D with tiny players running around -- a sharp contrast to the graphic style of the baseball portion of the game. The football game allows you to design your own plays and watch them with instant replay.

Chikyuu Kaihou Gun ZAS.name: Chikyuu Kaihou Gun ZAS
Chikyuu Kaihou Gun ZAS.summary: A vertical scrolling shooter/shmup released only in Japan. It's notable for using the DMG Game Boy's passive-matrix image retention (ghosting) to simulate transparency and multiple layers of parallax.

Doraemon Kart.name: Doraemon Kart
Doraemon Kart.summary: Based on the popular TV animation, Doraemon must race his friends and win the cup!

Spot - The Video Game.name: Spot: The Video Game
Spot - The Video Game.summary:
The Game Boy Port of "Spot!"
A puzzle game loosely featuring licensing from the 7Up soft drink. The gameplay involves up to 2 players, which can be either human or computer, each taking on spots of a particular colour. Starting from opposite corners, they take it in turns to move, either by 'reproducing' one of their spots to form another one in an adjacent square, or by making a jump, losing the square you did have but taking one two spaces away.

Tiny Toon Adventures 2 - Montana's Movie.name: Tiny Toon Adventures 2: Montana's Movie Madness
Tiny Toon Adventures 2 - Montana's Movie.summary: Here comes Montana Max the meanest movie maker to ever tarnish the silver screen. He's directed four new flicks that make Buster Bunny look like a villain! To defend his character Buster Bunny must leap into Max's movies and use attack moves like fast dash and freeze kick to change the endings before his career is finished.

Universal Soldier.name: Universal Soldier
Universal Soldier.summary:
Based on the major motion picture, this awesome action adventure takes you from the steaming shell-pocked jungles of Southeast Asia to laser-seared battlefields at home.

You are a perfectly engineered Universal Soldier with extraordinary skills and powers - locked in mortal combat against your old Vietnam foe, the villainous Sergeant Scott. You are both "Ultimate Fighting Machines", but only one of you can survive!

-Are you strong enough to conquer ten incredible locations?
-Your arsenal includes Triple Beam Lasers, Land Mines and a special Chaos Weapon.
